## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by` trailer, which `git commit -s` adds.
- [ ] `./mvnw clean verify` passes.
- [ ] A fix comes with a test that fails without it, and a feature comes with tests for the behaviour a user relies on.
- [ ] A change to a tool name, a schema, a result shape, a property or the public Java API has its line in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] The README says what a user has to know about the change.

CONTRIBUTING.md explains each of these.
